_doc: Every generated soundtrack cue: id (= file path under public/audio/music/ without .ogg), ACE-Step caption, bpm, key, time signature, duration (s) and seeds. tools/music/gen.py renders them, process.py loops/normalizes/encodes, pick.js chooses the best candidate and writes the manifest. See docs/music.md.
_suffix: , instrumental, no vocals, seamless loopable background music, consistent energy, studio quality
